source.title: 曾是體育班「唱作女聲」吳汶芳 放下麥克風她有個衝浪魂
source.description:
Wu Wenfang in Greenery

Taiwanese singer-songwriter Wu Wenfang is captured standing among lush ferns, her long brown hair cascading over a simple blue top. Known for her hit "The Sum of Solitude," she balances a musical career with athletic pursuits. 

An alumna of a sports class, Wu Wenfang channels her love for the ocean into surfing and freediving, and she often joins beach and mountain cleanups. In this serene portrait, her calm yet confident gaze reflects both her artistic spirit and her adventurous, eco-conscious lifestyle.

source.description:
Wu Wenfang’s Intimate Live Performance

Wu Wenfang, the Taiwanese singer-songwriter known for her hit “The Sum of Solitude,” takes the stage in a cozy setting, strumming her acoustic guitar and singing into a microphone. Dressed in a white sweater with a brown leather guitar strap, she beams at the audience under soft, blue-hued lighting. 

Her relaxed posture and genuine smile capture the warmth of a small-scale concert, where her emotive songwriting and clear vocals shine. This performance reflects her journey from personal lows to creative highs, as she shares her music and connects with fans through heartfelt melodies.
